title: Time after time: flowering phenology and biotic interactions
notes: Conceptual review covering pollinator herbivore and seed-predator effects on flowering phenology; all empirical timing citations must be logged.

title: Meta-analysis of phenotypic selection on flowering phenology suggests that early flowering plants are favoured
notes: Quantitative prior art: flowering-time and flowering-synchrony selection; supplement includes species effect sizes/moderators and original source references, plus pre-dispersal seed-predation analyses.

title: Pollination and seed predation by moths on Silene and allied Caryophyllaceae: evaluating a model system to study the evolution of mutualisms
notes: Reviews >30 Caryophyllaceae taxa and >50 cases; specifically identifies incomplete evidence on pollinator effectiveness seed predation seed set and selection. Used to close Hadena/Perizoma source universe without treating the review as empirical evidence.
